exam.name: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations
exam.notes: Reconciled against the official Exam Guide (v0.2) and a real exam pass. Domains, weights, task statements, and scenarios match the confirmed blueprint.

items.title: Exam overview & how to study
items.desc: Format, registration, and the recommended study order by domain weight (D1 → D3 → D4 → D2 → D5).

items.title: What is and isn't tested
items.desc: The exam's In-Scope and Out-of-Scope topic lists — read before diving in so you don't study the wrong things.

items.title: Claude with the Anthropic API (official course)
items.desc: Anthropic's free, in-depth course covering the Messages API, tool use, and prompting fundamentals used throughout the exam. Long, but a high-leverage foundation before domain prep.

items.title: Domain 1 study guide (Task Statements 1.1–1.7)
items.desc: Agentic loops, coordinator-subagent orchestration, context passing, enforcement/handoff, hooks, decomposition, and session management — each Task Statement with a deep-dive prompt and self-check.

items.title: Domain 3 study guide (Task Statements 3.1–3.6)
items.desc: CLAUDE.md hierarchy, slash commands & skills, path-specific rules, plan mode vs direct execution, iterative refinement, and CI/CD integration.

items.title: Domain 4 study guide (Task Statements 4.1–4.6)
items.desc: Explicit criteria, few-shot prompting, tool_use/JSON-schema structured output, validation-retry loops, batch processing, and multi-pass review.

items.title: Domain 2 study guide (Task Statements 2.1–2.5)
items.desc: Tool interface design, structured MCP error responses, tool distribution & tool_choice, MCP server integration, and built-in tool selection.

items.title: Domain 5 study guide (Task Statements 5.1–5.6)
items.desc: Context preservation, escalation & ambiguity, error propagation, large-codebase context, human review & confidence calibration, and provenance in synthesis.

items.title: Exercise 1: Multi-tool agent with escalation logic
items.desc: Build an agentic loop with 3–4 differentiated MCP tools, structured errors, a compliance hook, and multi-concern decomposition.
items.exam_note: Reinforces D1/D2/D5: agentic loop, tool descriptions, structured errors, hooks, escalation.

items.title: Exercise 2: Configure Claude Code for a team workflow
items.desc: Set up a CLAUDE.md hierarchy, glob-scoped .claude/rules/, a context:fork skill, MCP servers, and plan-vs-direct decisions.
items.exam_note: Reinforces D3/D2: configuration hierarchy, rules, skills, MCP integration.

items.title: Exercise 3: Structured data extraction pipeline
items.desc: Design a JSON schema with nullable/enum fields, a validation-retry loop, few-shot for varied formats, batch processing, and confidence-based human review.
items.exam_note: Reinforces D4/D5: tool_use schemas, retry loops, batch API, human review.

items.title: Exercise 4: Multi-agent research pipeline
items.desc: Orchestrate coordinator + subagents with explicit context passing, parallel Task calls, provenance-preserving structured output, error propagation, and conflict annotation.
items.exam_note: Reinforces D1/D2/D5: orchestration, context passing, error propagation, provenance.

sections.title: Exam scenarios (4 of 6 appear on the exam)

items.title: Scenario 1: Customer Support Resolution Agent
items.desc: Agent SDK + MCP tools; 80%+ first-contact resolution. Draws on D1, D2, D5.

items.title: Scenario 2: Code Generation with Claude Code
items.desc: CLAUDE.md, slash commands, plan mode. Draws on D3, D5.

items.title: Scenario 3: Multi-Agent Research System
items.desc: Coordinator + search/analyze/synthesize/report subagents. Draws on D1, D2, D5.

items.title: Scenario 4: Developer Productivity with Claude
items.desc: Built-in tools (Read/Write/Bash/Grep/Glob) + MCP. Draws on D2, D3, D1.

items.title: Scenario 5: Claude Code for CI/CD
items.desc: -p / --output-format json, automated PR review. Draws on D3, D4.

items.title: Scenario 6: Structured Data Extraction
items.desc: JSON schema via tool_use, validation/retry, batch API. Draws on D4, D5.

items.title: Decision heuristics cheat-sheet
items.desc: One page: the answer-elimination heuristics across all five domains. Run through it the day before.

items.title: Glossary & exam synonyms
items.desc: Terms and the synonym pairs the exam uses (orchestrator-workers = hub-and-spoke, primacy/recency, evaluator-optimizer, graceful degradation with transparency).

items.title: Easy-to-confuse pairs
items.desc: The subtle distinctions that separate a pass from a high pass — self-review vs self-critique, hook vs prompt, empty-result vs access-failure, and more.

items.title: Complete the official Anthropic Practice Exam
items.desc: The real calibration tool (unlimited attempts). Review every miss against the domain study guides above before booking the exam.

items.title: Take the certification exam
items.desc: The finish line: register and sit the exam.
